agyos_skill.intent: API documentation workflow for generating OpenAPI specs, creating developer guides, and maintaining comprehensive API documentation.
agyos_skill.instructions: Specialized workflow for creating comprehensive API documentation including OpenAPI/Swagger specs, developer guides, code examples, and interactive documentation. Use this workflow when: - Creating API documentation - Generating OpenAPI specs - Writing developer guides - Adding code examples - Setting up API portals - `api-documenter` - API documentation - `api-design-principles` - API design 1. Inventory endpoints 2. Document request/response 3. Identify authentication 4. Map error codes 5. Note rate limits ``` Use @api-documenter to discover and document API endpoints ``` - `openapi-spec-generation` - OpenAPI - `api-documenter` - API specs 1. Create OpenAPI schema 2. Define paths 3. Add schemas 4. Configure security 5. Add examples ```
